title: Iso-Heikkilä's Clubroom Booking
rule01_title: Cleaning and Condition of the Clubroom
rule01_body: You are responsible for the clubroom during your entire reservation. If you notice anything wrong when you arrive, such as broken items, an unclean area, or furniture out of place, report it to the Residents’ Committee immediately. Otherwise, you may be held responsible for problems found after your reservation.
rule01_list_title: Before returning the key, you must:
rule01_list_item01: Vacuum the floors and clean any areas you have used.
rule01_list_item02: Wipe down tables and other surfaces.
rule01_list_item03: Wash all dishes you have used.
rule01_list_item05: Remove your belongings and food and empty the refrigerator.
rule01_list_item06: Return all furniture to its original place.
rule01_list_item07: Close all windows and make sure the main door is properly locked.
rule01_body2: After each reservation, the clubroom may be inspected by the residents’ committee. If cleaning has been neglected or furniture is not in its original place, you may be required to correct the issues.
rule01_body3: If cleaning takes more time than normal maintenance requires, the residents’ committee has the right according to the agreement with TOAS to charge the cleaning fees from the person who made the reservation.
rule01_body4: If items have been broken and the act is considered intentional or clearly careless, you may be charged for the damage.
rule02_body: Return the key according to the agreed instructions immediately after your reservation. You are responsible for taking proper care of the key. Take good care of the key, If it is lost or damaged, the applicable cost may be charged to the person who made the reservation.
rule03_body: TOAS quiet hours are 22:00–07:00 and must be respected. During these hours, no noise from the clubroom or its users may disturb other residents.
rule04_title: Respect for Residents’ Committee Members' Privacy
rule04_body: Residents’ Committee members must not be disturbed at their private homes regarding clubroom reservations, keys, complaints, bans, or other clubroom matters.
rule04_body2: Do not come to a committee member’s apartment or appear at their door without prior permission or an agreed appointment. Committee members are residents too, and their privacy must be respected.
rule05_body: Each resident may reserve the clubroom a maximum of two times per month. Additional reservations are not allowed.
rule05_body2: We have zero tolerance for disturbances. Respect the clubroom, the surrounding residential areas, other residents, and the privacy of Residents’ Committee members.
rule05_body3: Violations of the rules may result in your booking rights being suspended or banned by the Residents’ Committee. TOAS is aware of the committee’s authority and decision-making process regarding clubroom booking restrictions.
addendum: For clubroom matters, contact the Residents’ Committee through the designated email address.
addendum2: These rules exist to keep the clubroom pleasant to use and to ensure that reservations can continue to be offered.
addendum3: By making a reservation, you agree to follow these rules.
understoodBox: I understand the rules and agree to follow these rules.
errorText: You must accept the rules to continue
